name: DSBench
why_it_matters: Newsrooms increasingly rely on AI to load messy datasets, run analysis, and draft accurate findings, mirroring exactly what this benchmark measures.
task_shape: Agents are given realistic data science tasks sourced from ModelOff and Kaggle, requiring them to load files, perform multi-step analysis or modeling, and produce answers or written conclusions.
signals: Uses authentic, long-context tasks with real spreadsheets and datasets rather than toy problems.
Reported model accuracy is low, so results may not reflect everyday journalism workflows that involve simpler tables.
